darwin.noKeyringNote: The macOS Keychain is not available; the token is kept in a private file (mode 0600) instead.
darwin.startAgainHint: launchd will not restart a clean exit; start it again with: launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/local.clawdyx
darwin.stopServiceHint: Stop the service from macOS: launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/local.clawdyx
darwin.startNeedsHint: You will need macOS (launchctl) to start it again.
darwin.setupNext:
make start      run the bot in the background now and at every login
  make run        or run it in the foreground (Ctrl-C stops it)
darwin.deniedSummary: rm, sudo, git push, curl/wget, brew, web tools
darwin.screenRiskNote: macOS will ask for Screen Recording and Accessibility permission.
darwin.cameraRiskNote: macOS asks for Camera permission the first time.
darwin.updateHint: Download the .dmg from the release page, quit clawdyX, replace it in Applications, then restart the worker.
darwin.automationExamples: open apps and files, scripts, osascript…
darwin.screenDeniedHelp: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording.
darwin.screenNote: macOS asks about once a month whether clawdyX may keep capturing the screen. The dialog appears on the Mac itself; until someone answers it there, screenshots from Telegram fail.
darwin.cameraDeniedStatus: Camera permission: not granted to clawdyX. System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera.
darwin.cameraDeniedFix: Turn on clawdyX in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera, then restart the worker.
darwin.cameraAskNote: macOS asks on the Mac the first time you send /camera.
darwin.noCameraFix: Connect a camera or open the lid of a MacBook.
darwin.screenGrantNote: Grant it to the clawdyX worker binary, then restart the worker. macOS ties the grant to the binary, so grant it again after each rebuild unless the binary is signed with a stable identity.
darwin.inputUnavailableFix: Grant Accessibility to the clawdyX worker, then restart it.

linux.noKeyringNote: No system keyring was found (normal on a server); the token is kept in a private file (mode 0600) instead.
linux.screenToolTrouble: that it is not available in this session (Wayland, or no graphical session)
linux.startAgainHint: Start it again on the computer with: systemctl --user start clawdyx (or clawdyx service start)
linux.stopServiceHint: Stop the service on the computer: clawdyx service stop
linux.startNeedsHint: You will need the computer (clawdyx service start) to start it again.
linux.serviceCommands: clawdyx service stop · clawdyx service status
linux.setupNext:
clawdyx service start   run the bot in the background now and at every login
  clawdyx run             or run it in the foreground (Ctrl-C stops it)
linux.deniedSummary: rm, sudo, git push, curl/wget, apt/dnf/pacman, web tools
linux.cameraPermission: access to the camera device (video group)
linux.screenNeeds: Needs an X11 session (Wayland: screenshots only).
linux.cameraRiskNote: Your user must be in the video group.
linux.updateHint: Download the package for your distribution from the release page.
linux.screenDeniedHelp: The desktop refused the capture; on Wayland, answer the screenshot dialog on the computer and try again.
linux.cameraDeniedStatus: No access to the camera device: add your user to the video group, then log in again.
linux.cameraDeniedFix: Add your user to the video group (sudo usermod -aG video $USER), log in again, then restart the worker.
linux.inputUnavailableFix: Mouse and keyboard tools need an X11 session; on Wayland they are not available yet.

windows.noKeyringNote: The Windows Credential Manager is not available; the token is kept in a private file instead.
windows.screenToolTrouble: that input was blocked (a window running as administrator, or the lock screen)
windows.startAgainHint: Start it again on the PC with: clawdyx service start (or from the clawdyX app).
windows.stopServiceHint: Stop the service on the PC: clawdyx service stop
windows.startNeedsHint: You will need the PC (clawdyx service start or the clawdyX app) to start it again.
windows.serviceCommands: clawdyx service stop · clawdyx service status
windows.setupNext:
clawdyx service start   run the bot in the background now and at every login
  clawdyx run             or run it in the foreground (Ctrl-C stops it)
windows.deniedSummary: rm, sudo, git push, curl/wget, winget, PowerShell, web tools
windows.screenRiskNote: No extra permission is needed; input cannot reach windows that run as administrator.
windows.cameraRiskNote: Windows asks nothing; camera access for desktop apps must be on in Windows Settings.
windows.updateHint: Download the installer from the release page and run it; it replaces the app and restarts the worker.
windows.screenDeniedHelp: The capture was refused; try again while the PC is unlocked.
windows.cameraDeniedStatus: Camera access for desktop apps is off: Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Camera.
windows.cameraDeniedFix: Turn on camera access for desktop apps in Windows Settings → Privacy & security → Camera, then try again.
windows.inputUnavailableFix: Input cannot reach windows that run as administrator, the lock screen or the sign-in screen.
